@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol shared with English: German keeps the Latin IEC 80000-13 symbols (KDE Dolphin de MiB → MiB, Microsoft Terminology de GiB/MiB unchanged), distinct from the SI kB/MB/GB.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol shared with English: German writes the decimal kilobyte as kB with the lowercase SI prefix (GNOME Nautilus de 4 kB / 4 MB), distinct from the binary KiB.

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol shared with English: German macOS Finder writes KB/MB/GB unchanged (pile de/macOS, size formatter strings), and SI keeps the lowercase k (kB).
